answer: A concrete approach: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. The glacier of work and the lagoon of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a lantern to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
